systems.name: creative-apps
systems.description: The AfterGlow suite's macOS app shells.

containers.name: SuiteModel
containers.description: Linux-safe values, contracts, fakes and pure logic shared by every app and the launcher. Foundation only; imports no app Model and no engine.

components.name: Identity and type registry
components.description: SuiteApp (the five apps and the launcher), bundle ids under one prefix (SuiteIdentity.prefix), and SuiteTypeRegistry: every document and pasteboard type each app reads and writes and the default app per type. Bundle/Info/*.plist mirror it; a test checks both.

components.name: Suite store
components.description: SuiteLocations (the support folder, -SuiteSupportDir override) and FileStore: revisioned JSON files written by atomic replace; a stale write re-reads, merges with the caller's pure merge, and retries.

components.name: Contracts
components.description: One protocol per suite use case (blueprint section 5): switching, recents, new documents, routing, hand-offs, round trip, pasteboard, assets, links, animation import, preferences, settings route, onboarding, updates, thumbnails, size budget.

components.name: Fakes and fixtures
components.description: A fake per contract with an unavailable reason, and SuiteFixtures (empty, week of work, round trip, assets) for snapshots and journeys.

components.name: Services
components.description: SuiteServices: one member per contract, .fake and the slots SuiteShell fills for .live.

components.name: Recents
components.description: RecentsList: merge, dedupe by file identity, cap 200, filter by app, search; the rules for when an app records.

components.name: Routing
components.description: Which app opens a type, the Open In list for a document, and Finder routing decisions for the launcher.

components.name: Hand-offs
components.description: HandOff values (verb, payload, return address), the versioned codec and the lifecycle (pending, accepted, returned, cancelled, expired).

components.name: Switching
components.description: Switch requests and receipts, run states, the Switch To menu model.

components.name: Home state
components.description: Home sections (new tiles and presets, recents grid, running apps strip), search and filter, HomeLayout column math.

components.name: Pasteboard coding
components.description: SuiteClipItem and its typed representations (suite asset envelope, SVG, PNG, colour, text); best-item choice for a target app.

components.name: Round trip
components.description: Library to Photo to Library edit sessions and their states.

components.name: Assets
components.description: SuiteAsset, SuiteSwatch, the asset index: add, update with a new revision, remove, search.

components.name: Links
components.description: AssetLink and its status (current, update available, missing) for placed assets.

components.name: Animation import
components.description: AnimationSummary of a .flare file (size, rate, length, scenes) for Halo's Open In.

components.name: Preferences
components.description: SuitePreferences (General and a pane per app), defaults, change records.

components.name: Onboarding
components.description: Onboarding pages, the person's choices, and when to show them.

components.name: Updates
components.description: Update feed parsing, version comparison, the offer and the install plan.

components.name: Packaging
components.description: BundleLayout (where each executable and framework sits, run paths), SizeReport and SizeBudget with evaluate.

containers.name: SuiteShell
containers.description: macOS glue every app process links: live conformances needing AppKit or Launch Services, shared menu commands, the adoption modifier.

components.name: Live services
components.description: SuiteServices.live and one slot file per member; each feature swaps only its own slot.

components.name: App launching and Switch To
components.description: Open or activate an embedded app (NSWorkspace.openApplication, NSRunningApplication.activate), run states, the Switch To commands.

components.name: Hand-off transport
components.description: Writes a hand-off file and opens it with the target app; receives one through onOpenURL.

components.name: Store watcher
components.description: Posts and observes the org.creativesuite.suite.changed distributed notification.

components.name: Pasteboard and drag bridges
components.description: Maps SuiteClipItem to NSPasteboard items and drag item providers and back.

components.name: Documents bridge
components.description: Records opens and saves in recents, writes thumbnails, builds the Open In submenu.

components.name: Adoption modifier
components.description: The .suiteApp(_:) modifier each app adds to its scene, and the settings route to the launcher.

containers.name: AfterGlowApp
containers.description: The launcher executable inside AfterGlow.app: home, assets page, settings, onboarding, updater, file router.

components.name: Launcher scene and router
components.description: @main AfterGlowApp: the home Window, the Settings scene, the onboarding window, and the router that forwards opened documents to the embedded app.

components.name: Home window
components.description: New tiles and presets, recents grid with search and app filter, running apps strip.

components.name: Assets page
components.description: The shared asset and colour library in the home sidebar.

components.name: Settings
components.description: One Settings window: General and one pane per app.

components.name: Onboarding
components.description: Three first-launch pages.

components.name: Updater
components.description: Check, offer sheet, progress, install and relaunch.

containers.name: AfterGlow bundle
containers.description: The packaged artifact's inputs: Info.plists with document and exported types, icons, the engine re-export file, the release graph in project.yml, scripts/bundle-apps and scripts/size-report (protected: supervisor merges).

components.name: Bundle inputs
components.description: Info.plists per bundle, icons, entitlements, and Bundle/Engines/CreativeEngines.swift (re-exports FlareCore, CoreRaster, CoreColor for the one shared engine framework).

containers.name: SuiteModelTests
containers.description: Model tests, contract conformance suites, model budgets, BuildGraphTests (Package.swift vs project.yml) and the registry-vs-plist check.

containers.name: AfterGlow journeys
containers.description: XCUITest bundle AfterGlowJourneyTests: drives the launcher and the apps through it; every shot audited.
